mapper.sql: i.id,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number,i.kind,v.title,i.status,i.current_version_id, CASE WHEN i.kind='FACT' THEN i.verification ELSE NULL END AS verification, CASE WHEN i.kind='FACT' THEN COALESCE(p.status,'UNAVAILABLE') ELSE NULL END AS project_status, v.content_json,NULL AS body
LEFT JOIN preparation_item p ON i.kind='FACT' AND p.owner_id=i.owner_id AND p.id=i.project_id AND p.kind='PROJECT'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM preparation_item i JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id
WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.status=#{status} AND i.id < #{afterId} AND ( v.title COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR (i.kind='TARGET' AND ( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.company')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.jd')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(v.content_json,'$.requirements[*]' COLUMNS (search_value VARCHAR(2000) PATH '$.text' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR)) required_text WHERE CONVERT(required_text.search_value USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') )) OR (i.kind='PROJECT' AND ( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.overview')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.technology')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' )) OR (i.kind='FACT' AND ( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.scenario')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.problem')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.action')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.result')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.technology')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' )) OR (i.kind='EXPRESSION' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.body')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') OR (i.kind IN ('FACT','EXPRESSION') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(v.content_json,'$.tags[*]' COLUMNS (search_value VARCHAR(40) PATH '$' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR)) tag_text WHERE CONVERT(tag_text.search_value USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' )) ) ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.prompt_json,'$.prompt')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.prompt_json,'$.conditions')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.prompt_json,'$.technology')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.prompt_json,'$.scenario')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(v.prompt_json,'$.tags[*]' COLUMNS (search_value VARCHAR(40) PATH '$' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR)) tag_text WHERE CONVERT(tag_text.search_value USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') ) ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: FROM material_excerpt e JOIN material_attachment a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id AND a.status='READY' AND a.sha256=e.attachment_sha256 LEFT JOIN material_parse_run r ON e.origin='PARSED' AND r.owner_id=e.owner_id AND r.id=e.run_id AND r.attachment_id=e.attachment_id AND r.attachment_sha256=e.attachment_sha256 AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' LEFT JOIN material_segment s ON e.origin='PARSED' AND s.owner_id=e.owner_id AND s.id=e.segment_id AND s.attachment_id=e.attachment_id AND s.run_id=r.id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND ( (e.origin='MANUAL' AND e.run_id IS NULL AND e.segment_id IS NULL AND e.start_offset IS NULL AND e.end_offset IS NULL) OR (e.origin='PARSED' AND r.id IS NOT NULL AND s.id IS NOT NULL AND e.start_offset IS NOT NULL AND e.end_offset IS NOT NULL) )

AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_excerpt_lifecycle lifecycle WHERE lifecycle.owner_id=e.owner_id AND lifecycle.excerpt_id=e.id AND lifecycle.attachment_id=e.attachment_id AND lifecycle.created_at=e.created_at))
